title: 13 PIECES OF BLUE & WHITE CORN...
reason: Genuine T.G. Green Cornishware (Judith Onions restyled mark), a collectable brand, 13+ pieces including the pepper shaker; likely $80-150 as a lot and more if sold piecemeal.
findings: Blue and white banded Cornishware: a pepper shaker with black PEPPER lettering, 2 large plates, further stacks of plates, small plates and 3 bowls. I count roughly 13 to 16 pieces in the photo (title says 13). Photo 2 base mark read in full: concentric-circle target mark with ORIGINAL CORNISH KITCHENWARE / BY T.G. GREEN, ENGLAND / RESTYLED BY JUDITH ONIONS DES. RCA. That is the post-1968 Judith Onions restyled range (produced into the 1980s), not the earlier pre-1960s Green shield-mark Cornishware, so it is a collectable maker but not rare. Only one base is shown; the other pieces are assumed to be the same range.
condition: No chips or cracks visible in the photos; light marks and minor crazing typical of use. Bases of the other pieces not shown.
rescore_note: Genuine T.G. Green Cornishware but the common later Judith Onions restyled range, 13 to 16 plain pieces with a pepper shaker and no chips seen; my estimate is about $80 to $130 as a lot.
